contact.reg: Ledger & Oak Accountants Ltd is a member firm of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales (ICAEW).

hero.title: Your numbers, sorted.
hero.lede: Accounts, tax returns and payroll for sole traders and small companies, at a fixed monthly fee. Scroll through one tax return, from a shoebox of receipts to filed.

stages.c: A self-employed electrician with a deadline in three weeks. A fixed fee agreed on the call.
Bank statements, invoices, a folder of fuel receipts and last year's return, all scanned in.
Every line categorised: income, expenses, bank and receipts. Nothing counted twice.
Two things flagged: an unclaimed home office, and mileage that's cheaper on the simplified rate.
A one-page summary of what you owe and when, before anything is filed.
Return submitted to HMRC with the confirmation saved. Twelve days before the deadline.
